summary.title: Executive Summary: Impact at a Glance
insights: India's ML researchers are making their mark with 67 papers at ICLR 2026, including 0 spotlight and 3 oral presentations that demonstrate the quality of research.
Positioned globally, India contributes 1.3% to the body of work at ICLR 2026.
Analysis of 31 first authorship and 26 majority authorship collaborations reveals trends in research leadership and international collaboration.
The India ML research landscape shows a mix of 19 academic and 15 corporate contributions, with leading institutions demonstrating significant research impact.
